pack.name: fleet-memory
pack.description: Built-in fleet memory-hygiene defaults (Phase 53 follow-up, Anima WI 01a0d569-1cf1 item 7). Compiled into the binary and installed on every akh as the default declaration tier; review of this file is its ADR 081 admission. Only predicates that hold one current value per subject by construction: the generic state predicates the Roman pack (deploy/roman-mini/schemas/roman-memory.json) proved on the 2026-09-24 store, and the two tool-manifest predicates the engine itself re-registers on every start. agent:* state predicates are excluded: the namespace is reserved and goal.rs already removes the old value before writing a new one (no multi-valued agent:has_status/has_priority subject in the 2026-09-25 store). Legitimately multi-valued predicates (agent:has_tag, agent:learned, tool:access, is-a, part-of, ...) are never declared. An akh's own pack overrides any relation here, including with an explicit "cardinality": "multi".
